title: 梅尔·金纸小叶
description: 深肤金饰梅尔穿完整象牙色长装，在桌前整理金色纸叶，光纹只作温和装饰。

art_direction.medium: thick wax crayon on warm paper
art_direction.identity: Mel is an elegant dark-skinned adult woman with intricately arranged dark hair, distinctive golden facial adornments, gold jewelry, and flowing ivory-and-gold clothing. Preserve her refined Medarda silhouette and warm expressive face while using a fully covering long-sleeved high-neck robe with opaque layers. Soft golden light patterns may surround her hands as quiet decoration, without a staff, weapon, or attacking spell.
art_direction.scene: She sits at a round table and arranges a handful of golden paper leaves around a plain little vase, considering their balance with a gentle smile. One folded cream cloth and a small cup complete the setting. A broad arched window offers warm light, and the modest craft remains more prominent than any subtle magical glow.
art_direction.palette: rich brown, ivory, soft gold, muted jade
art_direction.weapon_policy: iconic static prop, no attacks or firing

visual_qa.method: up to ten images on a compressed JPEG contact sheet, max edge 1280
